_comment: The phone script: everything the suspects say when you call them, in one place.
Edit this file to rewrite any conversation - it is read at runtime, so nothing needs rebuilding.
Each suspect is matched to the scene by 'name' (their display name, e.g. 'The Mayor', or their
prefab name, e.g. 'Mayor'). Any field left blank here falls back to what the suspect was authored
with on the Interrogation Room Director in MainScene.
basic          line 1 - what they say when they pick up, before any clue is put to them
nonsense       line 2 - their answer to a clue that means nothing to them
correct        line 3 - the moment the one true clue lands and they know they are caught
explanation    line 4 - them explaining themselves, one array entry per paragraph (can be long)
correctClueKey the clue that breaks them: a notebook clue key (see the director's 'List Clue
Keys' context menu) or another suspect's specialClueId
specialClueId  the id this suspect's special clue is unlocked under, so another suspect's
correctClueKey can point at it and the calls chain together
specialClue    the text of that special clue, read on the phone and written in the notebook
The detective (the player character) is not on the phone, so there is no entry for them here.

suspects.name: The Baron
suspects.basic: Baron speaking. Make it quick, detective.
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: Fine. Yes. I was there that night, and I have kept quiet about it ever since.
But you have to understand what was really going on at that table.

suspects.name: The Chief
suspects.basic: Chief here. This had better be important.
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: You think you have it all worked out. You do not.
Let me tell you what actually happened.

suspects.name: The Henchman
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: Alright, alright. I did what I was told, same as always.
But I never signed up for what happened after.

suspects.name: The Mayor
suspects.basic: You have reached the Mayor's office. Speak.
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: I have a reputation to protect, detective, and that reputation is the only reason I am still talking to you.
Here is the truth, and it goes no further than this call.

suspects.name: The Pianist
suspects.basic: Hello? I was in the middle of practising.
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: I see everything from that piano and no one ever notices me there.
So yes, I saw it. Let me tell you exactly what I saw.

suspects.name: The Widow
suspects.basic: Yes? Who is calling at this hour?
suspects.nonsense: I have nothing to say about that, detective.
explanation: I have grieved quietly and let everyone believe what they wanted to believe.
But you have earned the truth, so here it is.
